mapper.insert: insert into play_help_run_quota (topic_id, activity_id, play_instance_id, owner_member_id, quota_total, quota_used, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{playInstanceId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{quotaTotal}, 0, 0, now(3), now(3)) on duplicate key update update_time = update_time

insert into play_help_run_quota (topic_id, activity_id, play_instance_id, owner_member_id, quota_total, quota_used, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{playInstanceId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{quotaTotal}, #{quotaUsed}, 0, now(3), now(3)) on duplicate key update update_time = update_time
mapper.select: select q.*, case when json_valid(s.state_json) and json_type(json_extract(s.state_json, '$.originalGameSessionId')) = 'INTEGER' then cast(json_unquote(json_extract(s.state_json, '$.originalGameSessionId')) as unsigned) else null end as shared_run_id from play_help_run_quota q left join game_runtime_session s on q.play_instance_id = concat('game:', s.id) and q.topic_id = s.topic_id and q.activity_id = s.activity_id where q.topic_id = #{topicId} and q.activity_id = #{activityId} and q.play_instance_id like 'game:%' and ((s.owner_type = 2 and s.owner_id = #{teamId}) or s.id is null) having shared_run_id = #{gameSessionId} or shared_run_id is null
